from itertools import permutations

def solve():

    n = len(S)
    target = int(S, 16)
    digits = list(S)

    # Generate all unique permutations of the digits
    unique_perms = set(permutations(digits))

    min_val = None
    min_str = None

                min_val = perm_val
                min_str = perm_str

    if min_str is not None:
        print(min_str)
